title: Brand info — Content

fields.message: Brand info — site chrome, shown on every page. These are read directly by the plugin rather than filling a section's {{slots}}. A shortcode attribute still wins over anything saved here, for that one placement.

fields.label: Business name
fields.name: brg_brand_name
fields.instructions: Used wherever the company is named in copy.

fields.label: Email address
fields.name: brg_brand_email
fields.instructions: The general enquiries address. Referenced as #brand-email in a link, or [brand email] in text. Becomes a mailto: link on its own — type just the address.

fields.label: Phone number
fields.name: brg_brand_phone
fields.instructions: Written the way it should READ on the page, e.g. (760) 555-0134. Becomes a tel: link on its own, with everything except digits and a leading + stripped for the dialling part.

fields.label: Address
fields.name: brg_brand_address
fields.instructions: Shown on the contact page and anywhere the location is named.

fields.label: Careers email
fields.name: brg_brand_careers_email
fields.instructions: Where job enquiries go, if different from the general address. Referenced as #brand-careers_email.

fields.label: Instagram
fields.name: brg_brand_instagram
fields.instructions: Full https:// address of the profile. Leave blank and nothing linking to it shows.

fields.label: Facebook
fields.name: brg_brand_facebook
fields.instructions: Full https:// address. Leave blank and nothing linking to it shows.

fields.label: TikTok
fields.name: brg_brand_tiktok
fields.instructions: Full https:// address. Leave blank and nothing linking to it shows.

fields.label: LinkedIn
fields.name: brg_brand_linkedin
fields.instructions: Full https:// address. Leave blank and nothing linking to it shows.

fields.label: Privacy policy page
fields.name: brg_brand_privacy
fields.instructions: Path or full address of the privacy policy.

fields.label: Footer logo
fields.name: brg_brand_footer_logo
fields.instructions: The lockup shown in the middle of the footer on every page. It is artwork, not type — the words beside it in the code are only what a screen reader announces. An SVG keeps it crisp at any size; a PNG around 1400px wide also works. Leave empty to keep the built-in Blacktop lockup.

fields.label: Footer logo width
fields.name: brg_brand_footer_logo_size
fields.instructions: How wide the footer logo is, in pixels. It has been 360 at full width, which reads small on a wide screen. It never grows past the space available, so a large number here simply means 'as big as it fits' on a phone.

fields.label: Shortcode & options
fields.message:
Any field on this page can also be set right in the shortcode — that wins over what is saved here, for that one placement. Extra option: ttl="0" always fetches the newest copy.
